english: The area of the region $\{(x,y)\in\mathbb{R}^{2}:|x|+|y|\le 2,\ |y|\ge x^{2}\}$ is equal to
hindi: क्षेत्र $\{(x,y)\in\mathbb{R}^{2}:|x|+|y|\le 2,\ |y|\ge x^{2}\}$ का क्षेत्रफल बराबर है
solution: Both conditions are unchanged under $x\to -x$ and $y\to -y$, so the area is $4$ times the first-quadrant part.
First quadrant: $x^{2}\le y\le 2-x$, which needs $x^{2}+x-2\le 0\Rightarrow 0\le x\le 1$.
solution_full: Replacing $x$ by $-x$ or $y$ by $-y$ leaves both $|x|+|y|\le 2$ and $|y|\ge x^{2}$ unchanged, so the region is symmetric about both axes and its area is four times the area of its part in $x\ge 0$, $y\ge 0$.

In the first quadrant the conditions are $y\le 2-x$ and $y\ge x^{2}$. Such $y$ exists iff $x^{2}\le 2-x$, i.e. $(x+2)(x-1)\le 0$, so $0\le x\le 1$. The parabola $y=x^{2}$ meets the side $x+y=2$ of the square at $(1,1)$.
Check: the square has area $8$; the removed part $|y|<x^{2}$ has first-quadrant area $\int_{0}^{1}x^{2}dx+\int_{1}^{2}(2-x)dx=\dfrac13+\dfrac12=\dfrac56$, and $8-4\cdot\dfrac56=\dfrac{14}{3}$.
originality_note: New: the square |x| + |y| <= 2 with the inside of the four-armed parabola region |y| < x^2 removed (way 5). Closest known: area inside |x| + |y| <= a and above y = x^2. Different because: |y| >= x^2 keeps two opposite lens-shaped parts in all four quadrants and the symmetry in both axes is what reduces it to one integral.

concept_use.Area of regions bounded by modulus curve: The square |x| + |y| <= 2 gives the upper boundary y = 2 - x in the first quadrant.
concept_use.Area using symmetry of the region: Symmetry about both axes reduces the area to 4 times the first-quadrant integral.

stem_review: Read as a student: every curve and symbol introduced, region named by its bounding curves, one reading, answer unique and equal to the plan; options of one form; Hindi mirrors the English maths. Region given as a set, so there is one reading. Distractors: the removed area 10/3, and two slips. No change.
key_step: Use the symmetry about both axes and integrate 2 - x - x^2 on [0,1].
justification: Routine inequality region with symmetry and one integral, like 2021-P1-Q2 (L2).
